spec.title: OpenTelemetry Service Dashboard
spec.description: Single-service deep dive: RED metrics and slowest operations broken out by SpanKind (Server, Client, Internal, Async), with errors and recent logs side by side. Click a service in Traces Explorer to land here.

variables.name: database
variables.label: Database
variables.query: SELECT database FROM system.tables WHERE name IN ('otel_logs', 'otel_traces') GROUP BY database HAVING count(DISTINCT name) = 2 ORDER BY database

variables.name: service
variables.label: Service
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY ServiceName

variables.name: operation
variables.label: Operation
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT SpanName FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} ORDER BY SpanName

variables.name: search
variables.label: Search
variables.description: Free-text search applied to SpanName on trace panels and to log Body on the Logs panel. Leave blank to disable.

panels.title: Request Rate (Server)
panels.description: Server spans per second for ${service}: incoming requests this service handles. The R in RED.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, count() / $__interval_s AS rps FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Error Rate (Server)
panels.description: Fraction of Server spans for ${service} with StatusCode = 'Error'. The E in RED.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, countIf(StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR')) / count() AS error_rate FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Duration Percentiles (Server)
panels.description: P50, P90 (solid) and P99 (dashed orange) Server span duration for ${service}. The D in RED.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, quantile(0.5)(Duration) AS p50, quantile(0.9)(Duration) AS p90, quantile(0.99)(Duration) AS p99 FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Slowest Server Operations
panels.description: Server operations for ${service} ranked by P99 duration. Click an operation to open the matching trace search in Traces Explorer.

queries.query: SELECT SpanName AS Operation, count() AS Count, quantile(0.5)(Duration) AS P50, quantile(0.99)(Duration) AS P99 FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY SpanName ORDER BY P99 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Request Rate (Client)
panels.description: Client spans per second for ${service}: outgoing requests this service makes to its dependencies. The R in RED.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, count() / $__interval_s AS rps FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind = 'Client' AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Error Rate (Client)
panels.description: Fraction of Client spans for ${service} with StatusCode = 'Error'. The E in RED.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, countIf(StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR')) / count() AS error_rate FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind = 'Client' AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Duration Percentiles (Client)
panels.description: P50, P90 (solid) and P99 (dashed orange) Client span duration for ${service}. The D in RED.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, quantile(0.5)(Duration) AS p50, quantile(0.9)(Duration) AS p90, quantile(0.99)(Duration) AS p99 FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind = 'Client' AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Slowest Client Operations
panels.description: Client operations for ${service} ranked by P99 duration. Use these to spot slow dependencies. Click an operation to open the matching trace search in Traces Explorer.

queries.query: SELECT SpanName AS Operation, count() AS Count, quantile(0.5)(Duration) AS P50, quantile(0.99)(Duration) AS P99 FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind = 'Client' AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY SpanName ORDER BY P99 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top Errors
panels.description: Operations with errors for ${service}, ranked by error count, with the SpanKind that produced them. Click an operation to open the matching trace search in Traces Explorer.

queries.query: SELECT SpanName AS Operation, SpanKind AS Kind, StatusMessage AS Error, count() AS Count, max(Timestamp) AS "Last Seen" FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY SpanName, SpanKind, StatusMessage ORDER BY Count DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Logs for ${service}
panels.description: Recent logs for ${service}. Click a row to expand attributes.

queries.query: SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, SeverityText AS level, ServiceName, TraceId, SpanId FROM ${database}.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Message Rate (Async)
panels.description: Async spans (Producer + Consumer) per second for ${service}: message production and consumption against queues / event buses.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, count() / $__interval_s AS rps FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind IN ('Producer', 'Consumer') AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Error Rate (Async)
panels.description: Fraction of Async (Producer + Consumer) spans for ${service} with StatusCode = 'Error'.

queries.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, countIf(StatusCode IN ('Error', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR')) / count() AS error_rate FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind IN ('Producer', 'Consumer') AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Slowest Async Operations
panels.description: Async (Producer + Consumer) operations for ${service} ranked by P99 duration. The Kind column tells you whether each row is a Producer or a Consumer.

queries.query: SELECT SpanName AS Operation, SpanKind AS Kind, count() AS Count, quantile(0.5)(Duration) AS P50, quantile(0.99)(Duration) AS P99 FROM ${database}.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = ${service:singlequote} AND SpanKind IN ('Producer', 'Consumer') AND $__conditionalAll(SpanName IN (${operation:singlequote}), $operation) AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(SpanName, '$search') > 0, $search) GROUP BY SpanName, SpanKind ORDER BY P99 DESC LIMIT 20
